name: print-social-duotone-dj-portrait-with-gradient-geometric-tile-mosaic-post
title: DJ Portrait with Gradient Geometric Mosaic
whatItIs: A square post for a DJ with a red-and-teal duotone portrait of a man in a roll-neck on navy at the left, a mosaic of coral half-discs, a dark circle, a teal starburst and cream-to-teal gradient arrows and diamonds at the right, and a dark panel with 'DJ VILLAR', genres in italic, a short line and a website, plus social icons on a cream base.
whatItMeans: A mosaic of simple shapes in gradient fills echoes music rhythm, and the duotone portrait ties into the palette.
techniques: Red and teal duotone lighting on the portrait
Mosaic of geometric tiles with gradient fills
Repeating half-discs, arrows and diamonds as rhythm
Dark text panel with rules around the genres
Social icons and handle on a light base

vocabulary.definition: Lighting a subject with two contrasting colours.
A grid of tiles each holding a simple graphic.
A shape filled with a smooth colour blend.
